lines.trans: As head of the Second Production Unit, I have to ask Mr Xie a question on behalf of our department.
Our unit's commentary show has consistently earned strong ratings and growing public influence.
Yet under the new policy Mr Xie proposed, I cannot figure out which category our show falls into.
If it counts as domestic it gets axed, and even if it counted as imported, it did not come through Mr Xie.
Your show is naturally an exception; later I will bring overseas stars onto the show to boost its buzz.
I do not think that approach is appropriate.
How is it inappropriate? And who might you be?
Xingtian now represents a huge roster of pop singers plus film and television actors from the Donghai merger.
It is no exaggeration to say we now hold half the entertainment industry's talent.
So company productions cannot consider only show needs; they must also coordinate with talent management.
We must use our own programme platforms to prioritize developing our own in-house artists.
Bringing on too many foreign artists at the expense of our own agency business is far from wise.

examples.text: 东海是业内规模最大的经纪公司。
examples.trans: Donghai is the largest talent agency in the industry.

examples.text: 那家经纪公司旗下有很多著名歌手。
examples.trans: That talent agency represents many famous singers.

examples.text: 制作组正在跟各大经纪公司沟通档期。
examples.trans: The production team is coordinating schedules with talent agencies.

examples.text: 老大康复之前，工作上的事我们绝不打扰他。
examples.trans: Until our boss recovers, we will never bother him with work.

examples.text: 在节目品质上，一部绝不敷衍了事。
examples.trans: On show quality, Unit One never cuts corners.

examples.text: 你来这儿大半年了，在幸福面前，何必考虑什么人事压力？
examples.trans: You've worked here over half a year amid constant gossip — in the face of happiness, why worry about office politics?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 这是自己。
examples.trans: This is 自己.

examples.text: 排播规划不能只看短期利益，还要兼顾平台自身定位。

examples.text: 打铁还需自身硬，提升自身实力才是最好的回应。
examples.trans: Strengthening your own capability is always the best answer.
